name: Passive Capacitor — 16V — AVX
description: Cluster of 16V SMD passive capacitor parts using AVX-C(2312) footprints from the Seeed OPL KiCad library.
selection_hints: Select when requiring 16V SMD capacitors with AVX-C(2312) footprint compatibility.
Verify part specifications such as capacitance and ratings against circuit requirements.
Check footprint dimensions and tier B status prior to PCB layout commitment.
avoid_when: Operating voltages other than 16V are required.
Designs require through-hole mounting or footprints other than AVX-C(2312).
A tier A library qualification is mandatory.
